theorem induction_divisibility_3div2tooddnp1
  (n : ℕ) :
  3 ∣ (2^(2 * n + 1) + 1) := by
  have h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ∣ (2^(2 * n + 1) + 1) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      norm_num
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.mul_succ]
      simp [pow_add, pow_one, Nat.mul_succ] at ih ⊢
      norm_num at ih ⊢
      omega
  exact h n

theorem induction_divisibility_3divnto3m2n
  (n : ℕ) :
  3 ∣ n^3 + 2 * n := by
  have h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ∣ n^3 + 2 * n := by
    intro n
    have h₁ : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by omega
    rcases h₁ with (h₁ | h₁ | h₁)
    · -- Case n % 3 = 0
      have h₂ : 3 ∣ n := by
        omega
      have h₃ : 3 ∣ n^3 + 2 * n := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h₂
        use k^3 + 2 * k
        rw [hk]
        ring_nf
        <;> simp [hk]
        <;> omega
      exact h₃
    · -- Case n % 3 = 1
      have h₂ : n^3 + 2 * n = 3 * (n^2 + n) + 1 := by
        have h₃ : n % 3 = 1 := h₁
        have h₄ : n = 3 * (n / 3) + 1 := by omega
        rw [h₄]
        ring_nf
        <;> simp [h₃]
        <;> omega
      have h₃ : 3 ∣ n^3 + 2 * n := by
        rw [h₂]
        exact ⟨n^2 + n, by ring⟩
      exact h₃
    · -- Case n % 3 = 2
      have h₂ : n^3 + 2 * n = 3 * (n^2 + n) + 2 := by
        have h₃ : n % 3 = 2 := h₁
        have h₄ : n = 3 * (n / 3) + 2 := by omega
        rw [h₄]
        ring_nf
        <;> simp [h₃]
        <;> omega
      have h₃ : 3 ∣ n^3 + 2 * n := by
        rw [h₂]
        have h₄ : 3 ∣ 3 * (n^2 + n) + 2 := by
          omega
        exact h₄
      exact h₃
  exact h n

    apply Finset.ext

    constructor

        · exfalso

theorem mathd_algebra_421
  (a b c d : ℝ)
  (h₀ : b = a^2 + 4 * a + 6)
  (h₁ : b = 1 / 2 * a^2 + a + 6)
  (h₂ : d = c^2 + 4 * c + 6)
  (h₃ : d = 1 / 2 * c^2 + c + 6)
  (h₄ : a < c) :
  c - a = 6 := by
  have h₅ : a^2 + 4 * a + 6 = 1 / 2 * a^2 + a + 6 := by linarith
  have h₆ : a^2 + 4 * a = 1 / 2 * a^2 + a := by linarith
  have h₇ : 1 / 2 * a^2 + 3 * a = 0 := by linarith
  have h₈ : a = 0 := by
    have h₈₁ : a * (1 / 2 * a + 3) = 0 := by linarith
    have h₈₂ : a = 0 ∨ 1 / 2 * a + 3 = 0 := by apply eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero h₈₁
    cases h₈₂ with
    | inl h₈₂ => exact h₈₂
    | inr h₈₂ =>
      have h₈₃ : a = -6 := by linarith
      have h₈₄ : a < 0 := by linarith
      have h₈₅ : a^2 + 4 * a + 6 = 1 / 2 * a^2 + a + 6 := by linarith
      have h₈₆ : 1 / 2 * a^2 + 3 * a = 0 := by linarith
      have h₈₇ : a = 0 := by linarith
      linarith
  have h₉ : c^2 + 4 * c + 6 = 1 / 2 * c^2 + c + 6 := by linarith
  have h₁₀ : c^2 + 4 * c = 1 / 2 * c^2 + c := by linarith
  have h₁₁ : 1 / 2 * c^2 + 3 * c = 0 := by linarith
  have h₁₂ : c = 0 := by
    have h₁₂₁ : c * (1 / 2 * c + 3) = 0 := by linarith
    have h₁₂₂ : c = 0 ∨ 1 / 2 * c + 3 = 0 := by apply eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero h₁₂₁
    cases h₁₂₂ with
    | inl h₁₂₂ => exact h₁₂₂
    | inr h₁₂₂ =>
      have h₁₂₃ : c = -6 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₄ : c < 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₅ : c^2 + 4 * c + 6 = 1 / 2 * c^2 + c + 6 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₆ : 1 / 2 * c^2 + 3 * c = 0 := by linarith
      have h₁₂₇ : c = 0 := by linarith
      linarith
  have h₁₃ : a = 0 := h₈
  have h₁₄ : c = 0 := h₁₂
  linarith
